description: Create a new Ionic application using the Ionic CLI.
title: Creates an Ionic project in the workspace

name.description: The name of your new project (e.g. myApp, "My App").
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the project?

template.description: The starter template to use (e.g. blank, tabs).

x-prompt.message: Which starter template would you like to use?

items.label: tabs - A starting project with a simple tabbed interface
sidemenu - A starting project with a side menu with navigation in the content area
list - A starting project with a page that displays a list of items

directory.description: The directory of the new project.

type.description: Type of project to start (e.g. angular, react, vue).

x-prompt.message: Which JavaScript framework would you like to use?

capacitor.x-prompt: Would you like to include Capacitor integration?

id.description: Specify an Ionic App ID to link.

projectId.description: Specify a slug for your app (used for the directory name and package name).

packageId.description: Specify the bundle ID/application ID for your app (reverse-DNS notation).

noGit.description: Do not initialize a git repo.

link.description: Connect your new app to Ionic.

tags.description: Add tags to the project (used for linting).
